In article <8e40st$v0g$1@nnrp1.deja.com>,
  pyro1488@my-deja.com wrote:
> In article <007c4386.376bdd4c@usw-ex0105-034.remarq.com>,
>   Mowhak <mowhak@unicum.de> wrote:
> > pyro1488@my-deja.com
> >    Message 1 of 1
> > Leftist Masochism
> >
> > *~"Notice the masochistic tendency of leftist tactics. Leftists
> > protest by lying down in front of vehicles, they intentionally
> > provoke police or racists to abuse them, etc. These tactics may
> > often be effective, but many leftists use them not as a means to
> > an end but because they PREFER masochistic tactics. Self-hatred
> > is a leftist trait." (Paragraph 20)
> > --T. Kaczynski~*
> >
> > -We may find something worthwhile in here, and I almost agree
> > with TK here. But what else does he suppose as a counter-attack?
> > There is not much left (if you're one of those leftist sissys who
> > do not dream of killing your enemies more brutally than they
> > would like to kill you).
>
> Ted Kazcynski believes that both modern leftism and "hate groups" have
> arisen out of a feeling of alienation within society, brought in large
> part by technological advancement.  He sees them as surrogate
> activities.  TK proposes that the techno-industrial system be
> demolished and that humans return back to nature.  Again, from his
> perspective "racism" is a symptom of a disease, and not the root of
the
> problem.  I will point out that in his Manifesto he sees leftism as a
> much greater problem, or symptom, than racism itself.
>
> I happen to believe he was a bit disingenuous in his Manifesto.  I
> concur with Agent99's classification of TK as an "anarcho-fascist."
He
> was (ironically) a bit PC in his Manifesto to garner support, in my
> view.

I realize this post needs supplementary sidenotes. ;-)

This can be interpreted as a contradiction, and it is.  I believe that
TK did not deliberately lie in his Manifesto.  I believe that TK may
have been (to an extent) the oversocialized individual he painted many
leftists to be, to the extent that he opposed racism.

I should have phrased the first sentence: "Ted Kaczynski stated.."
(rather than believed).  TK also "stated" that hate groups and leftism
are surrogate activities.  My analytical skills are getting worse than
Buchanan's... (j/k) please excuse me before I get really bad and say TK
was a "mediocre genius!"

Cheers,
Pyro
